content:
dave: FYI customer acme-inc reporting widespread decrypt failures after last night's key rotation. They see AccessDenied in app logs and KMS shows 'EncryptionContextMismatch' for many decrypts.
carla: Can you paste the error snippets and the exact time window? also which key alias?
dave: window 2026-06-08 03:12-03:40 UTC, alias arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-rotated. Example app error: "KmsClientError: AccessDenied: encryption context mismatch"
alice: Any chance the proxy or STS session is dropping the X-Redwood-EncCtx header we pass? We had a similar issue with the HSM proxy last quarter.
dave: Customer says their wrapper does send enc ctx. I grabbed the proxy logs, ones that failed show header absent: 
```
[2026-06-08T03:15:21Z] conn=12 req=387 proxy_headers={Host: kms.redwood, Authorization: ...} // X-Redwood-EncCtx: <MISSING>
[2026-06-08T03:15:21Z] response=403 KMS EncryptionContextMismatch
```
eric: Could be a header size or charset problem after rotation if we started signing with new key id. Also check STS session policy/serialization: if session policy is baked into temp creds and enc ctx keys differ it is a mismatch.
carla: dave, can you run a repro with curl from the proxy host and include the enc ctx explicitly? e.g. 
```
curl -v -H "X-Redwood-EncCtx: tenant=acme;job=ingest" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <proxy-token>" \
  https://kms-proxy.internal/v1/decrypt -d '{"ciphertext":"..."}'
```
dave: ran that just now, when header present decrypt succeeds. When header stripped by our nginx sidecar, decrypt fails. So sidecar config likely.
alice: Glad we have repro. Two actions: 1) patch nginx sidecar to forward X-Redwood-EncCtx (quick fix). 2) run audit to list all decrypt attempts without enc ctx between 03:00-04:00 and correlate to tenant. I'll prepare a query.
kms-bot: Audit query executed: 114 decrypt attempts without enc ctx between 2026-06-08T03:10:00Z and 03:40:00Z. Top 3 tenants affected: acme-inc, beta-suite, and internal-test. Link: https://audit.redwood/logs?query=missing_encctx&from=2026-06-08T03:10
eric: Also check KMS grants for the HSM key after rotation. If the grant-grantee principal changed due to alias swap, decrypts signed with old grant might be denied.
dave: I'll verify grant chain and nginx config. putting a temporary rule to always proxy X-Redwood-EncCtx for affected tenants. Will update here in 20m. :hourglass: 
carla: Please include repro steps and paste minimal nginx snippet you change for postmortem. Keep customer updated.
dave: noted. quick nginx snippet we used to fix:
```
proxy_set_header X-Redwood-EncCtx $http_x_redwood_encctx;
proxy_pass_request_headers on;
```

alice: After fix, we should rotate the proxy signing cert back to previous rotation window to avoid mixed enc ctx formats. Also add a regression test in deploy pipeline to assert enc ctx header forwarding.
eric: +1 on test. Also add an alert if decrypt success rate drops >5% after future key rotations.
dave: update: applied nginx patch on two proxy nodes, verified decrypt path for acme-inc green. pushing hotfix to canary. will coordinate with support on customer comms.
carla: thanks — add timeline and affected tenant list to the incident ticket. we'll follow up with root cause postmortem.
